label: <DEL> delimiter in short sequences (L=3, often L=4)
explanation: Mostly a short-sequence delimiter unit. About 72% of activation mass is on the <DEL> step, and only when L<=4. At L=3 it fires on ~97% of delimiters, and these are the strongest activations (top examples are all L=3, e.g. z z u <DEL>). At L=4 it fires on only ~27% of delimiters, more often when the first token is e/z/w/g/0/u. The remaining ~28% of mass is weak firing at original step t=2 (plus some at t=3/4), almost always on a first-occurrence token, more often for in_tok z/1/d/q/f and first token e. Token sets did not separate these weak hits cleanly. Never fires at t=0/1, at t>=5, during the copy phase, or at the delimiter of sequences with L>=5. Simple predicate dev: F1 0.43, mass recall 0.72.
